description: Current advertised mortgage offers (fixed, variable and mixed) from the Spanish banks barcelona-rent.fyi reads weekly, each with TIN and TAE with and without bonificaciones, the Euríbor spread, and — given a price, deposit and term — the monthly payment, the payment after any switch to Euríbor, and the total paid. Sorted by bank, never ranked. These are advertised representative rates, not binding offers.

bonified.description: Use the rates with bonificaciones where advertised (default true)

depositPct.description: Deposit as a percent of the price (default 20)
